# 6.15 The result of a parallel floating-point reduction, inside its bound
Part: the result of a parallel floating-point reduction, inside the bound whatever its order
Clause: [reduce], [numerics.defns], [algorithms.parallel.exec], [basic.fundamental]
After: 6.14
Levels: c++17
Source: Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., §4.2; IEEE 754-2019 §4.3

## Example
```cpp
#include <execution>
#include <numeric>
#include <print>
#include <vector>

int main()
{
    //: Hold integers that a float stores exactly.
    std::vector<float> x {16777216.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};
    //: Let std::reduce group and order the additions as it likes.
    float sum {std::reduce(std::execution::par,
                           x.begin(), x.end())};
    //: Bound the error by gamma(n - 1) times the sum of sizes.
    long long n {3};
    long long size {16777218};
    long long bound {(n - 1) * size / (16777216 - (n - 1))};
    //: Compare the error with the bound, never with one order.
    long long error {static_cast<long long>(sum) - 16777218};
    std::println("{}", error <= bound && -error <= bound);
}
```

## Alone 1
Form: run
Flags: -pthread -ltbb
Write a program that reads n integers and adds them as float values with std::reduce under std::execution::par. Let S be the exact sum, A the sum of the absolute values, and E the absolute difference between the float result and S. Higham (Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., §4.2) bounds E by γ(n − 1)·A for every order of the additions, where γ(k) = k·u / (1 − k·u) and u = 2^−24 (IEEE 754 single precision). Print that bound rounded down to an integer. Then print inside if E is at most the bound, else outside.
Input: line 1, n; line 2, the n integers.
Output: two lines: the bound rounded down, then inside or outside.
Limits: 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000; every integer between −16777216 and 16777216.
### Examples
```in
3
16777216 1 1
```
```out
2
inside
```
```in
2
5 -7
```
```out
0
inside
```
### Reference
```cpp
#include <bit>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <execution>
#include <iostream>
#include <numeric>
#include <print>
#include <vector>

int main()
{
    long long n {0};
    std::cin >> n;
    std::vector<float> x(n, 0.0f);
    long long exact {0};
    long long size {0};
    for (float& v : x) {
        long long read {0};
        std::cin >> read;
        v = static_cast<float>(read);
        exact += read;
        size += std::llabs(read);
    }
    float sum {std::reduce(std::execution::par,
                           x.begin(), x.end())};
    long long got {static_cast<long long>(sum)};
    long long error {std::llabs(got - exact)};
    long long steps {n - 1};
    long long bound {steps * size / (16777216 - steps)};
    std::println("{}", bound);
    std::println("{}", error <= bound ? "inside" : "outside");
}
```

    auto top {static_cast<unsigned long long>(n - 1)};
    long long steps {std::bit_width(top)};
    long long bound {steps * size / (16777216 - steps)};
    std::println("{}", bound);
    std::println("{}", error <= bound ? "inside" : "outside");
}

## Alone 2
Form: run
Write a program that reads three integers a, b and c, each held exactly as a float. Print every value that std::reduce under std::execution::par may return for the floats a, b and c, with its default start value of 0. Every addition is a float addition.
Input: one line, a, b and c.
Output: each value as an integer on its own line, smallest first, each value once.
Limits: every integer between −16777216 and 16777216.
### Examples
```in
16777216 1 1
```
```out
16777216
16777218
```
```in
1 2 3
```
```out
6
```
### Reference
```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <print>
#include <vector>

int main()
{
    long long ra {0};
    long long rb {0};
    long long rc {0};
    std::cin >> ra >> rb >> rc;
    float a {static_cast<float>(ra)};
    float b {static_cast<float>(rb)};
    float c {static_cast<float>(rc)};
    std::vector<float> sums {(a + b) + c, (a + c) + b,
                             (b + c) + a};
    std::ranges::sort(sums);
    auto [first, last] {std::ranges::unique(sums)};
    sums.erase(first, last);
    for (float s : sums) {
        std::println("{}", static_cast<long long>(s));
    }
}
```
